column3: Held close to the pace early - driven approaching final furlong to hit front - stayed on strongly to win
Settled at the back - produced with a run on the far rail from 1f out and keeping on well despite the jockey losing the stick - finished with real purpose to take second in the closing stages
Handy early - pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on same gear to the line - finished third
Settled off the pace early - asked for effort inside final furlong and finished with running on well - grabbed fourth close home
Held up in the pack - angled right and made progress from 2f out - kept on into 5th but never a danger
Sent forward early - clear in front until pressed with a furlong left - overtaken close home - faded to finish sixth
Slow to break - settled towards the back - pushed along inside the final furlong - crept on late finishing seventh beaten 3 lengths
Settled mid-pack early - pushed along with 2f left - unable to quicken and beaten into 8th
Settled in the pack early - driven and dropped back with 2f left - well held at the finish
Sluggish getaway - settled at the back - urged forward with 2f left - moved through into contention inside the final furlong - hit the front late and stayed on strongly to win

Settled in the pack early - crept forward with 3f left after a squeeze for effort - hit the front inside the final furlong - overtaken again with a furlong to run - drifted right in the closing stages - unable to reel in the winner and finished second

Set the pace early - overtaken and slipped to third after 5f - urged on and gave up the position with 3f left - fought back to reclaim third spot inside the final furlong but nudged off stride close home to finish third
Settled close up early - roused to hit the front two out then overtaken inside the final furlong - lost ground close home to finish fourth
Settled in the pack early - moved through to hit the front after 5f - pushed along and overtaken 2f out - faded quickly and allowed to drop away final furlong
Held a midpack position early - pushed along and found room passing rivals inside final furlong - powered clear in the last 110 yards - kept driving through the line to win
Away early to take up a forward spot - angled right and pushed along inside final furlong - stayed on strongly late to snatch second near the line
Up with the leaders - pushed along inside the final furlong - ran on at one speed to finish third
Set the pace early - pushed along a furlong out then lost front spot inside final 110 yards - held for fourth without finding more
Settled at the back early - pushed along inside final furlong and moved through the field - unable to make real headway late finishing fifth
Settled at the back early - urged forward past two furlongs out - improved through the field in the closing stages - finished sixth without threatening the front runners
Settled midpack early - driven for effort with 2f left - unable to quicken - well beaten in 7th
Settled just off the pace - pushed along with two furlongs left - dropped away in the closing stages - finished 8th
Sat behind the front group early - third at halfway then closing into second inside the final 2f - hit the front with 100 yards to run - stayed on strongly to win
Driven early towards the back - progress made in the last two furlongs to sit 5th with a furlong left - finished strongly to snatch second late
Settled midfield - 6th at halfway - driven approaching 2f out to move into 3rd early in the final furlong - stuck on same gait to finish 3rd
Went straight to front - driven approaching final furlong then overtaken close home - unable to find more finishing 4th beaten 1¾ lengths
Sat close up early - disputed second at halfway then slipped to third and pressed for effort a furlong out - unable to find further gains inside the final 150 yards finishing fifth
Held up towards the back - driven into contention approaching final 2f then 7th with a furlong left - stayed on same gear to finish 6th
Held up towards the back - driven to no avail 2f out - stayed on same gait late to finish 7th
Settled midpack early - still 7th at halfway and pressed for effort with 1 1/2f left without gaining - stayed on at same tempo through the closing stages to finish 8th
Sat close to the pace early - 4th at halfway - driven with two furlongs left and down to 6th inside the final furlong - unable to find more and finished ninth
Sat close to the front group early - 5th at halfway - driven approaching final furlong and slipped to 8th - unable to find more late finishing 10th
Held up at the back of the field - driven inside the final 2f but made no headway - finished without response
Set the pace from the off - driven and challenged 2f out - lost the advantage inside the final furlong - fought back to hit the front close home - held on to prevail
Settled close up early - upped tempo to challenge outsider 2f out - drove ahead inside final furlong - overtaken in the last 110yds and beaten into 2nd
Handy in the pack early - urged forward two out then eased right approaching final furlong - stayed on same gait to finish third
Settled in the pack - pressed for effort with 2f left - moved into contention approaching the furlong pole - up into fourth and kept going to the line
Settled in the pack - pushed along and squeezed for space 2f out - unable to find more finished fifth
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along inside final 2f - unable to land a challenge - finished sixth well beaten
Settled just off the pace - improved into contention 3f out and pushed along 2f out - lost place approaching final furlong to finish seventh
Settled at the back - nudged for effort with over 2f left - made no impression thereafter - finished well beaten in 8th
Tracked the front group early - driven up to challenge inside final 2f and hit the front late - forged clear to score
Set the gallop in front early - pushed along inside the final furlong and edged off a straight course - overtaken near the finish - unable to find more late on
Settled just behind the leader early - urged forward approaching 2f out - stayed on under pressure inside final furlong - unable to threaten the front pair and yielded second near the finish
Held up towards the back - driven up and made headway over 2f out - hampered hard when disputing places approaching final furlong - kept on well to finish 4th closing best
Settled in the pack early - pushed along with a furlong left - finished with running on but always short of the front - fifth at the line
Settled in the pack early - asked for effort with 2f left and drifted right under pressure - unable to threaten the front-runners - finished sixth beaten 4.5 lengths
Slow to break - held towards back - driven from 2f out to close late finishing 7th
Settled towards the back of the pack - urged forward with 3f left - unable to find any headway thereafter
Settled in the pack - driven approaching 2f out but unable to find headway - hampered inside final furlong and unable to make it up - finished well held
Tracked front group wide - urged forward with two furlongs left - faded quickly from there - finished tenth
Sat close to pace early - urged forward with over 2f left - lost ground with more than a furlong to run - finished 11th
Held up towards back of the pack on the outside - driven for effort with over 2f left - showed no response - finished well beaten in 12th
Settled in the pack early - urged forward around the halfway mark - dropped away thereafter - finished well back in 13th
Held up towards the back - never involved with the front group - finished well held
Settled midfield on the wide side - up to 4th at halfway - hit the front inside the final furlong - driven out in the closing stages to assert late

Up with the front runner - dropped to 3rd at halfway - stumbled 2 furlongs out - pushed into action over 1f out - drifted left in the final furlong - moved into second inside the last 150 yards and stayed on to finish second beaten 3.5 lengths
Settled in the pack early - 5th at the midpoint - pushed forward under pressure with 2f left and finished 3rd keeping on to the line

Settled midfield - 10th at the halfway point - made steady progress into contention 5f out - hit the front over 2f out - came under pressure and lost the advantage inside the final furlong - faded close home to finish fourth
Settled midpack - 6th at halfway - shaken up and edged into contention over 2f out - stayed on from the furlong marker - unable to find more inside the final 150 yards to finish 5th
Held up early - close to last at halfway - lost touch approaching the final furlong and finished no threat

Went straight to front and travelled keenly early - lost command after 2f - sat second at halfway - hit front again 4f out - overtaken and driven over 2f out - lost touch rapidly with a furlong left - allowed to drop away nearing the line to finish well held
Settled at back early - urged forward with slight progress approaching 2f out - driven on again inside final 3f - lost ground steadily from there to finish well beaten in 8th
Settled midfield - 8th at halfway before fading fast 4f out - well beaten from 3f out and finished last of all
Sat close to the pace early - 7th at halfway - pushed forward 4f out - lost touch 3f out and finished well beaten
Settled close up early - hit front after 2f and opened a five length gap by halfway - urged on before being overtaken 4f out - faded fast and slipped to the rear - well held from 3f out home
Held up in last place - lost more ground before halfway under pressure - soon well behind and eased out of contention 5f out - pulled up
Settled in the pack early - driven up into second inside the final furlong before going ahead close home - stayed on strongly to win

Sat behind the front-runner early - up to second by the midpoint - moved through to hit the front with a furlong and a half left - pressed for effort and overtaken close home - stayed on without further response for second
Held up early - improved before 2f out - 5th with a furlong left - pushed along and finishing strongly to snatch 3rd near the line
Settled towards the back early - made progress inside the final 2f to move into 3rd with a furlong left - pushed along and stayed on well to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - driven for effort 2f out and into 6th under pressure with a furlong left - stayed on same gallop to finish fifth
Sat close to the front group - 4th at halfway - driven approaching final furlong but couldn't quicken - held on for sixth
Sat close behind pace - third at halfway - pressed for effort inside final furlong but couldn't quicken and held late
Sat just behind front group - 5th at halfway - dropped away under pressure inside final 2f and held no finishing kick
Held up at the back - lost touch with the field early - driven inside final 2f without response and beaten well before the line
Went straight to front - driven up and lost the advantage with a furlong and a half left - unable to find more and allowed to drop away inside the final 150 yards
Settled in the pack - pushed along and moving through inside final furlong - hit the front close home - drew away to win with ease
Sat close to the pace - pressed for effort inside final 2f - stayed on well through the last furlong - grabbed second close home but never able to challenge the winner
Held up in the pack - driven into contention approaching final furlong to briefly move up to second - edged back before the line - stayed on same rate for third
Settled at the back early - pushed hard and finding little three furlongs out - responded inside final furlong to finish fourth
Settled at the back early - urged forward approaching final two furlongs - shortened the gap late but couldn't land a blow
Settled in the pack early - dropped back over 2f out - pushed along soon after - found some late headway 1f out - kept on late but never a threat to leaders
Sent clear early - pressed for effort a furlong out then lost the advantage in the final furlong - faded quickly after finishing 7th
Held up mid-pack early - driven and slipped towards the back with 3f left - unable to threaten leaders through the finish - eventually well held in 8th
Settled at the back of the field - pushed along with over 2f left - made no impression and beaten well into ninth
Held up handily early - dropped away under pressure inside final furlong - faded rapidly to finish well beaten
Up with the head two early - driven to take command over 1f out - asserted through the final 110yds to score readily
Raced close to the pace early - pushed along over a furlong out - stayed on to the finish - held by the winner in second
Went clear early - driven approaching final two furlongs and overtaken inside the last - held on for the same effort to the line
Settled in the pack early - urged forward with over two furlongs remaining - stayed the course but outpaced with a furlong left - finished fourth beaten around nine lengths
Slow to break - held up towards the back - urged forward with over 2f left - stayed on without threatening the placings
Sat close to the front group early - roused with three furlongs left - dropped away inside the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - urged to improve with two furlongs left - dropped away final furlong - finished seventh well beaten
Held up towards the back - driven for effort with over two furlongs left but made no impression - eventually finished eighth
Hesitant start - unfurnished and back of the field for the whole trip - well held in 9th
Settled in midfield - scrappy over 7th - moving well to hit the front before 2 out - lurched left at both remaining obstacles - driven out and holding sway to the line
Held handy early despite errors in fluency - blundered four out - pushed forward to move into second before the last - stayed on but couldn't get past winner

Went straight to front - matched from the 2nd before losing top spot approaching 3 out - scratchy at that fence - driven from there - couldn't find more from 2 out - dropped away on the run to the line
Towards the back - nudged for effort after 3 out - faded from 2 out and well held in 4th

Held up towards the back and going wide - lost place at the 2nd - some way off the pace after the 5th - given a squeeze for a moment after the 7th - urged forward approaching three out - eventually well held in 5th

Tracked front pair early - shared advantage after 2nd - hit the front before 3 out - impeded by a loose horse after that - overtaken and driven before 2 out - lost touch rapidly from there to finish sixth

Settled around midpack on the outer - hesitated and got a shove early on - awkward at the 3rd - clipped the 8th - unbalanced again and slipped towards the back 4 out - labouring badly 3 out - pulled up soon after
Settled towards the back - lost balance and parted company with rider at the 4th
Quick start into second spot to halfway - asked for effort to hit the front two out - stormed away inside the last for a comfortable win
Went straight to front - driven early in straight before losing top spot 2f out and unable to close on winner late - stayed on same gait to finish second
Settled at back early - driven approaching 2f out - up to 3rd inside final furlong but unable to threaten leaders - finished third
Held third spot early - nudged for effort with 2f remaining - asked for more soon after and unable to close in the closing stages - well held at the finish in 4th
Settled second early - closed on pace-setter with 2f left - hit front a furlong out and quickly stamped authority - kept finding under pressure - pulled clear to score
Held up towards the back - improved from the final furlong - moved into second close home - stayed on well but unable to trouble winner

Sat in third early - travelled wide of rivals - slipped to fourth with 2f left - driven approaching final furlong - fought back to third close home and stayed on to finish third beaten under five lengths
Set the pace early - opened a three-length advantage approaching 2f out - margin narrowed and front spot lost inside the final furlong - dropped away rapidly close home to finish fourth
Settled towards the back early - lost touch with leading group approaching final two furlongs - stayed on late without threatening finished 5th
Set the pace from the off - stayed clear of rivals throughout - kicked on with two furlongs left - eased through in the closing stages to score without being pressed
Sat handy behind the front group early - moved into second by halfway and asked for effort - kept responding to the line but well behind clear winner in 2nd
Sat close to pace early - squeezed for space on the rail after a furlong - into gear approaching final furlong - kept on to finish third beaten 4.5 lengths
Settled in the pack - improved to fourth approaching the final 2f - driven out but stayed at one gear to the line
Held up towards the back - urged forward with 2f left - stayed on late finishing fifth beaten 6 lengths
Settled in midfield - asked for effort inside final 2f - unable to find any headway - finished sixth
Shifted across left after the start - settled towards the back - unable to make an impression - finished well beaten in 7th
Held up eagerly early - up with the pace - squeezed for effort and faded two furlongs out to finish 8th
Sluggish start - stayed at the back throughout - dropped further off the pace 2f out - well held at the finish
Held up towards back of the pack - nudged for effort with over 2f left - drifted markedly right and found nothing - finished well beaten in 10th

Settled in the pack - wide on the circuit - moved to the front after the 5th - not foot-perfect at the 8th and 13th - five lengths up at halfway - 20 lengths to the good three out - asked for effort after 2 out - checked before an untidy jump at the last - kept going on the run-in and won with plenty in hand

Went straight to front early - overtaken shortly after and slipped to 4th by halfway - stumbled 3 out - worked back into 2nd approaching 3 out - driven and dropped that spot before 2 out - roused again and closed up before last - kept going for the runner-up spot but no answer to the winner
Settled towards the back of the pack - error at the 7th - up to 6th by halfway - stumbled 3 out - driven into 2nd before 2 out but faded on the run to the line
Settled towards the back early - sluggish jumping around 3rd - untidy at 5th - improved into fourth under pressure after 3 out and again before the last - finished well beaten in 4th
Towards the back from the start - lost more ground before the 9th and never travelling well - laboured jumping in the closing stages - plugged on at the one speed up the run-in to finish 5th

Towards the rear of the field and wide - serious blunder at the 9th - 8th at halfway - jumping untidy at the 11th - ridden after 3 out - another sketchy leap 2 out - dropped away on the run-in to finish 6th
Held up early - down the field by 4th and 7th at halfway - pushed for effort after 3 out - dropped away before 2 out and well held at the finish
Held up handy early - hit front after 2nd then lost lead before 4th - slipped to 5th by halfway - faded further before 11th - mistake 12th and lost touch with field - well beaten from 3 out home

Handy early - hit front for a spell then lost it after 2nd - back in command before 4th then overtaken at 5th - error at 7th - second at halfway - driven and faded fast beyond 3 out - pulled up before the last
Held up in midfield - stumbled twice through the field - up to 3rd by halfway - urged into effort but slipped backwards after 3 out - pulled up before the final fence
Set the pace from the start - four lengths to the good by halfway before the gap shrank turning into the straight - driven out two furlongs from home and found more to prevail in the final furlong
Settled behind pace-setter - improved to challenge before straight - driven out from 2f and battled to go down by a head
Tracked the front-runner early - third and nearing the lead turning in - driven with 2f left but couldn't get on terms - stayed on at one gait to finish third
Held up towards the back - urged forward entering the straight and still tenth with two furlongs left - finished strongly out wide to snatch fourth late
Held up towards the back - still 7th at halfway - driven approaching straight and stayed on late to finish 5th
Settled midfield early - up to 5th and pushed along with two furlongs left - stayed on inside the closing stages to finish 5th
Settled midfield - sixth and driven approaching 2f out - stayed on inside final furlong to finish 5th
Driven early and settled at back - urged into mid-race progress in straight - still 8th with 2f left then edged forward under pressure to finish one-paced
Settled behind pace early - up to 4th by halfway and improving into the straight - pushed along 2f out but flattened out inside the final furlong to finish ninth
Held up at the back - urged into effort early in the straight - unable to find more inside final furlong - well held in 10th
Held up at the back - driven approaching straight without gaining ground - no response inside final 2f - finished well beaten in 11th
Settled towards the back of the pack - driven for effort but making no headway early in the straight - couldn't quicken and dropped away inside the final furlong - finished well beaten in 12th
Driven forward early - hit front straightaway - edged ahead approaching final two furlongs - opened daylight inside last - allowed to coast home unchallenged for the win
Held up in third - nudged forward to close 2f out - moved into second over 1f out - stayed on inside the final furlong but unable to peg back the winner
Went straight to the front - overtaken and settled into second - driven and dropped a spot over a furlong out then stayed on steadily to the line
Settled among the front group - lost touch with the pace 2f out - dropped away close home to finish 4th
Held up towards the back - unable to quicken with leaders and slipping further behind 2f out - well held through the last furlong

Held up towards the back of the pack - progress made approaching the last two furlongs moving left and finding a path between rivals - hit the front inside the final furlong - pushed out and finished going away well - clear-cut winner

Settled in the pack early - asked for effort with over 2f left and edged left to find room - closed on the front pair with a furlong to go - kept responding to the line but couldn't match the winner's finishing speed
Up with the leaders on the wide outside - took the front over 2f out - drifted left and was passed inside the final furlong - kept on at one speed to finish third
Settled towards the back - urged forward and made ground approaching final 2f - driven but unable to quicken final furlong - finished 4th beaten 3.25 lengths
Sat handy behind pace - driven approaching 2f out and still in contention entering final furlong - weakened late to finish 5th
Sat close to the front group - driven approaching 3f out and again inside the final furlong - unable to close the gap
settled around midfield - nudged for effort with over 2f remaining - unable to find any extra gear - beaten into 7th
Held up in the pack - driven approaching the last two furlongs - kept on without getting near the front runners
Slow into stride - settled at the back - unable to feature and well held
Settled in the back half - ridden to make ground 2f out - beaten comfortably from 1f out
Slow to break - held up at back - driven over 2f out but made no impression
Set the pace early - urged on and lost front spot approaching 2f out - lost momentum and squeezed for room inside final furlong before well held at the finish
Held handy position early - asked for effort 3f out - dropped away 2f out to finish well beaten

Set the pace early - error at the 8th and lost the front before 9th - drifted left 4 out - scratchy at the 3rd out - driven and drifted left before 2 out - awkward again 2 out and at the last - regained command after the last - clear on the run-in - scored easily

Held a forward spot early travelling keenly - hit the front before the 9th and stretched clear by two lengths at halfway - driven up when overtaken after 2 out - unable to find more and lost ground before the last - drifted left at the final fence - unable to threaten again - finished second well held
Tracked the pace early - slipped to 4th by halfway - hit a flat spot 3 out - urged forward before 2 out then lost touch - never in contention late

Held up towards the back - 5th at halfway - stumbled 4 out - urged forward after 3 out - drifted left approaching 2 out - clipped the fence 2 out - dropped away before the last and finished well beaten
settled midfield - up to 3rd by halfway - stumbled 3 out and slipped back after - driven approaching last - unable to threaten leaders and well held
Settled towards the back - mistake 4th and losing touch soon after - asked for effort past 7th and again past 10th - well beaten from before 4 out - finished 6th

Settled in the pack early - hit the second and struggled for fluency at the fourth and ninth - up to sixth by halfway - stumbled at the eleventh - driven on after four out but losing touch with the rest ten lengths adrift - retired before the second last
Sat just behind the pace early - still in second at the midpoint - asked for effort to hit the front a furlong out - driven out and battled on to the line as the margin narrowed
Sat close behind the front group early - up to 3rd approaching 2f out under pressure - responded strongly in the closing stages to finish second beaten a half-length
Sat handy behind front pack - 3rd at halfway - driven approaching straight then 4th with a furlong left - stayed on late to finish 3rd
settled towards the back of the field - niggled into contention from 2f out and 7th over 1f out - strong late surge to take 4th close home
Settled in the middle of the pack - asked for effort over 2f out and up to 5th with 1 1/2f left - stayed on at one gait inside the closing furlong to finish 5th
Urged to the front early - driven to stay clear over 2f out before losing the advantage inside the final furlong - unable to find more in the closing stages and finished 6th
Held up towards the back - nudged for effort with 2f remaining - 6th passing the furlong marker - stayed on same gait to the line - finished 7th beaten 3.5 lengths
Held up at the back - driven approaching final 2f with little response - stayed on same gait through closing stages - finished 8th beaten 6¾ lengths
Held up at back of field - driven approaching 2f out but made no headway - beaten before the finish - well held in 9th
Held up in midfield - driven approaching the straight but making no headway two furlongs out - unable to find more and faded to finish 10th
Sat close to front-runner from the off - asked for effort 2f out and battled gamely to the line - got up close home to prevail
Set the pace under pressure from the off - urged forward approaching the final two furlongs and edged left - battled on well in a prolonged tussle - caught close home to finish second
Up with the early movers - driven and flat 2f out - unable to land a blow on the leading pair and kept on at one speed for 3rd
settled midpack - driven approaching 2f out to move into fourth - held that spot to the finish
Settled in the pack - pushed along with 2f left - kept going without threatening - finished 5th
Sat close to the front group early - urged for effort with over 2f remaining - dropped away before the final furlong to finish sixth
Settled in the pack - ridden to make progress 3f out - dropped away inside the final furlong
Held up towards back - never involved - well beaten in 8th
Held a forward position early - urged on before losing touch over 2f out - dropped away in the closing stages - finished 9th
Settled behind the pace early - untidy at the 6th - up into 2nd by halfway - moved through to hit the front before 2 out - driven clear approaching the last and stayed on well to the line
settled in the pack - 4th at halfway - driven on approaching 2 out - jumped awkwardly there - kept on and drifted left up the run-in to finish 2nd
Set the pace early - clipped fence 4th and stumbled at 8th - driven on and lost front spot before 2 out - blundered at 2 out - urged approaching last - faded on the run-in
held up towards the back of the pack - still 7th at halfway - pushed into contention approaching 2 out - lost momentum before the final fence and jumped it awkwardly - never a threat late on

Settled towards the back early - fumbled first - fifth at halfway - improved position wide before 7th - stumbled 4 out - lost touch before 2 out - clumsy again 2 out - driven out on run-in but well held
up with the early pace - jumped poorly and dropped back at the 2nd - 6th at halfway - another untidy jump at the 7th - pressure applied before 2 out - blundered 2 out and fell away before the last
Settled towards the back - pulled hard through the early stages - not consistent at the fences - well adrift before 3 out and fading before 2 out
Settled in the pack early on keen rein - up to 3rd by halfway - stumbled at the 8th - dropped back after 4 out - driven and faded before 2 out - beaten well out the back at the finish
Settled towards the back - keen early on - error at the 2nd - then error and hesitant at the 6th - asked for effort after the 8th but pulled up before 3 out
Held up towards the back of the pack - squeezed for space and driven out with 2f left before angling left approaching the final furlong - finished strongly in the last 150 yards to get up and score
Settled midfield early - urged into contention and up to 3rd inside final 2f - stayed on strongly to finish 2nd beaten a short head
Settled towards the back - driven into contention 2f out and up to 4th with a furlong left - finished strongly to be third by a short head
Sat behind the front pack early - 3rd at halfway - moved through to hit the front approaching the final furlong under pressure - stayed on but caught in the last strides to finish 4th
Sat behind pace early - up to 2nd by halfway - shaken up to hit front 2f out but overtaken inside final furlong - unable to find more close home
Held a midfield spot - asked for effort inside final 2f and up to 5th early in straight - squeezed for space close home and finished without full pressure
Settled around midfield - still 6th at halfway - eased over towards the rail under pressure inside the final 2f and stayed on to finish 7th beaten a length and a half
Settled towards the back - driven into contention approaching 2f out but 8th with a furlong left - squeezed for space inside the final 100 yards to finish beaten 2 lengths in 8th
Sluggish start - held up towards the back - asked for effort with 2f left and boxed in a furlong out then eased left and stayed on at one speed inside the final furlong - finished 9th
Went straight to front early - shaken up and lost command 2f out then dropped to 5th under pressure inside final furlong - held no more late and finished 10th
Hampered leaving the stalls and settled at the back - shaken up with two furlongs left but made no headway - held no chance late and finished well beaten in 11th
Settled early towards the front and pulling hard - 4th at halfway - dropped away with 2f left - unable to find more late and well held at the finish
Urged early to sit close behind front group - 5th at halfway - eased back through field 2f out and held no finishing kick
Handy on the wide side - driven to the front inside final 2f - shaken up with a furlong left - found more to go clear in the last 110yds - won comfortably
Sat close to the pace - asked for effort 2f out and moved into second - kept responding but couldn't get to the winner close home - finished second beaten 2.5 lengths
Sat close to front group early - nudged for effort with 2f remaining - stayed on at one level to finish third
Set the pace early - driven approaching 2f out and lost the advantage soon after - kept going without finding more inside the final furlong to finish fourth
Held up towards the back - driven approaching the final furlong - kept battling to the line - finished fifth beaten 9.5 lengths
Settled midfield early - driven for effort with two furlongs left - unable to find any headway - finished sixth beaten 9¾ lengths
Held up towards the back - urged with over 2f left - found nothing - finished 7th
Held up in midfield - urged for effort with over 2f remaining - dropped away inside the final furlong - finished eighth
Slow to break - settled towards the back - never involved - well held at the finish
Slow to break - always down the field showing signs of inexperience - never landed a blow - finished well beaten in 10th

Sat up behind the front-runner and travelled with plenty of enthusiasm - swept to the front before the 5th - opened a clear three-length gap by halfway - cruising with two to jump - pushed further clear after the second-last - stayed on strongly up the run-in - always in command

Settled towards the back early - awkward jump at the 2nd - down in 10th at halfway - error 4 out - crept into contention approaching 2 out then found extra to move up into 2nd before the last - driven out and stayed on well but not enough to land the spoils - finished 2nd
Bumped early - settled in the pack - 6th at halfway - moved through wide before 4 out - driven approaching 2 out - responded to hold third and battled on to the line

Set the pace early - lost front spot before the 5th - up in second at halfway - pressed for effort before 2 out - hit a rough step there - lost touch before the last - stuck on for 4th without threatening the leaders
up with the front runner - 4th at halfway - pressure applied before 2 out - dropped away after 2 out and jumped the last awkwardly - well held in 5th
Settled midfield early - clumsy leap at 1st - up into 3rd by halfway - error at 6th - faded fast approaching 2 out then blundered there - no response under pressure on run-in - finished 6th
towards the back - erred at the 5th - 11th at halfway - not smooth at the 3rd last - nudged up before 2 out and stayed on at one tempo on the run-in to finish 7th
Held up handy early - 5th at halfway - dropped away approaching 2 out - fluffed the fence there - unable to respond after and beaten well into 8th
settled around midfield early - drifted right at the 5th - 7th at the halfway point - lost touch and pushed on after 3 out - some slight improvement before 2 out but always found wanting
